title: A real dispute remains only with Protestants who think unfallen man needed no supernatural help to escape death
source_text: XXX. Dissidium solum quoddam reale remanebit inter eos ex Protestantibus qui volunt, sine omni auxilio supernaturali, hominem integrum mortem in perpetuum potuisse vitare, & Scholam Romanam quae id communi consensu negat.
pass_a_gloss: Only a certain real disagreement will remain between those of the Protestants who hold that, without all supernatural aid, integral man could have avoided death forever, and the Roman School which by common consent denies that.
pass_b_english: The only real disagreement left will be between those Protestants who hold that unfallen man could have escaped death forever without any supernatural help, and the Roman school, which by common consent denies it.

choices.why: Contrasts with the verbal dispute of the previous thesis.
